## What was produced

`tests/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVRecordAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 3.8 test class (`extends junit.framework.TestCase`, compatible with `junit-3.8.1.jar`), in package `org.apache.commons.csv` so it can reach the package-private `CSVRecord(String[], Map<String,Integer>, String, long)` constructor and the package-private `putIn`/`values` methods. It uses only `-source 8` syntax (no diamonds, lambdas, or literal underscores) and defines all fixtures inline (a private `Header` enum plus `newRecord` / `headerMapping` builders).

### Coverage, grounded in `api/CSVRecord.html`

| Method | Happy path | Boundary / error |
|---|---|---|
| `size()` | value count; cross-checked vs `values().length` and iterator count | empty record → 0 |
| `get(int)` | value at each 0-based column | index == size → `IndexOutOfBoundsException`; negative index → same |
| `get(String)` | mapped values; documented `null` value preserved | no mapping → `IllegalStateException`; unmapped name → `IllegalArgumentException`; inconsistent record → `IllegalArgumentException` |
| `get(Enum)` | resolves by `name()`; equals `get(String)` | enum name not mapped → `IllegalArgumentException` |
| `getComment()` | returns supplied comment | `null` when none |
| `getRecordNumber()` | returns supplied number | `0` and `Long.MAX_VALUE` |
| `isConsistent()` | true when no mapping / sizes match | false when header size ≠ record size |
| `isMapped(String)` | true/false per defined names | false when no mapping |
| `isSet(String)` | true when mapped **and** value present | false when mapped-but-no-value; false when unmapped; false when no mapping |
| `iterator()` | all values in order | `NoSuchElementException` after exhaustion |
| `toMap()` | header→value entries | empty when no headers; omits column with no value; fresh detached map per call |
| `putIn(M)` | populates and returns the *same* map instance | leaves pre-existing entries intact when record has no headers |
| `values()` | returns values in order | — |
| `toString()` | non-null, reflects values | — |
| type contract | `instanceof Serializable` and `Iterable` | — |
